subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for the remaining Claude CLI prompt-fingerprint restart class, and should the next fix prioritize announce static-prompt symmetry, live-fingerprint stable/volatile splitting, or both together?
rationale: Current main has already merged soft-resume and group-turn stabilizers, but source still shows announce-path static prompt omission and live-session fingerprint restarts; choosing the durable invalidation contract is a maintainer-owned runtime policy decision.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Fix Both Layers
options.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and require the next fix to thread stable prompt facts through announce turns while excluding only volatile prompt bytes from live-session identity.

options.title: Split Live Fingerprint To Sibling
options.body: Use this issue only for extraSystemPrompt/announce symmetry and track full systemPromptHash live restarts in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81041.

options.title: Close After Narrow Group Fix
options.body: Treat the original groupIntro trigger as enough to close this issue and leave later announce/live-process reports to new or existing sibling issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Fix Both Layers
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as canonical and require the next fix to thread stable prompt facts through announce turns while excluding only volatile prompt bytes from live-session identity.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged soft-resume policy and recent group prompt hash fixes that set the current boundary for this decision.
